reviews.text: I really like this blush - the texture is lovely and the shade is just right. The colour payoff isn’t strong, but that’s not a criticism; I actually prefer it that way. I’ve been reaching for it often over the summer, and it’s become one of my favourite products of the season.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款胭脂——質地好好，色號又啱啱好。顯色唔算強，但我唔係喺度批評，事實上我反而更鍾意咁樣。成個夏天我都成日攞嚟用，佢已經成為我今季最愛嘅產品之一。

reviews.text: I love this blush so much it had a cute print on it. I write reviews at least after using my products after a week and it has nice light pigment so it doesn’t seem too much if u want u can layer it for a brighter pigment. I use it when I have no makeup and want Rosy nose and cheeks to look a bit sunkissed. It’s not heavy and not creamy or dry it’s perfect for either oily or dry skin.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款胭脂，佢上面有個得意嘅圖案。我通常用咗產品至少一個星期先寫評價，佢嘅顯色好自然，所以唔會太誇張；想再出色少少嘅話，可以一層層疊上去。我喺冇化妝嘅時候會用佢，想整到鼻同面珠有啲曬後嘅粉紅感。佢唔厚重，又唔會太潤或者太乾，無論油性肌定乾性肌都好啱用。

reviews.text: Perfect amount of pigment for a great blurry blush and easy to use. Absolutely love this color. I’m on the cooler side and it’s a little warm on me but it’s perfect to add some warmth for a summer makeup look.
reviews.zh: 顯色剛剛好，做到好好睇嘅柔焦胭脂效果，而且好用。我完全愛上呢個顏色。我本身膚色偏冷調，呢隻色對我嚟講有少少暖，但用嚟為夏日妝加啲暖意就啱啱好。

reviews.text: Es un color muy bonito, solo que lo dejé de sombra ya que es muy claro para ser rubor en mi tono de piel… aún así así yo me equivoqué en la elección del tono, la fórmula es maravillosa y queda muy lindo
reviews.zh: 顏色好靚，只不過我留咗佢做眼影用，因為以我嘅膚色嚟講，佢做胭脂太淺喇……不過咁樣都係我自己揀錯咗色號，呢個配方其實好正，上妝效果好好睇。

reviews.text: ‏I purchased the shade #01 Calm Pink and absolutely loved it! My skin has a warm, light-medium yellow undertone. I expected a deeper shade, but it appeared lighter than I imagined—a soft, buildable pink. While it appears quite light at first, it blends seamlessly into the skin with a smooth, velvety texture. I just need to layer it a bit more for the color to show up clearly on my complexion. The formula is lightweight and easy to blend.
reviews.zh: 我買咗 #01 Calm Pink 呢隻色號，完全愛上咗！我嘅膚色係暖調、中淺黃底調。本來以為會深啲，但出嚟比我想像中淺——係一隻柔和、可以層疊嘅粉紅色。雖然初睇落好淺，但用喺皮膚上會好順滑咁融為一體，質地滑溜似絲絨。我只係需要疊多一兩層，顏色先至可以清楚咁顯現喺我嘅膚色上。配方輕盈，容易推開。

reviews.text: I guess it just too light for my skin.. I’m shade 21 usually but this blush just doesn’t seem on my face:(
reviews.zh: 我諗對我嘅膚色嚟講太淺喇……我平時用 21 色號，但呢款胭脂喺我塊面好似唔存在咁 :(

reviews.text:
Pretty blush! Unfortunately, I’ve ordered Warm Coral twice now and both times received Yakgwa Brown instead. I figured it wouldn’t happen twice, but it did. I’d really love to see what Warm Coral is like lol 
I gave the second one to a friend.
reviews.zh:
胭脂幾靚！可惜我已經兩次落單要 Warm Coral，兩次都收到 Yakgwa Brown。我以為唔會再撞錯，結果又撞錯。我真係好想睇吓 Warm Coral 究竟係點嘅樣 lol
第二盒我已經送咗畀朋友。

reviews.text: In the photos, I swiped my cheeks two times. A buildable blush. I prefer two swipes for a natural look. Swapper my shirt out for the third photo to show a color difference. This blush appears brighter with brighter clothes.
reviews.zh: 相入面我各抹咗兩下面珠。呢款係可以層疊嘅胭脂。我自己就鍾意抹兩下，感覺自然啲。第三張相我換咗件衫，係想展示顏色上嘅分別。配淺色衫嘅時候，胭脂睇落會更加明亮。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
